evals.prompt: I need research help for our checkout redesign. Since launching one-click checkout last month, completion went from 41% to 46% but repeat purchase stayed flat at 18%. Leadership wants to know what to improve before our May campaign. We mostly care about Gen Z users in HCMC and Hanoi.
evals.expected_output: Structured brief with complete business performance, enhanced measurable objective, target audience definition, timeframe feasibility, and classification.

evals.prompt: Can you make a brief from this: research everything about user behavior across all products. Need by next Friday. No metrics yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent should narrow overscoped objective, ask focused clarification questions, and avoid fabricating missing metrics.

evals.prompt: I pasted a draft brief below. Please clean it and only ask what is missing. Context: We launched referral rewards for wallet users. KPI target is +12% referral conversion in Q3. Objective: understand if messaging is clear. Segment: first-time senders and inactive senders. Deadline: Apr 18, report needed before creative lock on Apr 22.
evals.expected_output: Agent extracts existing fields without re-asking, enhances objective, and returns ready status if complete.

evals.prompt: Use the info below and do not ask duplicate questions. We launched installment payments in January. MAU grew from 220k to 248k, but successful payment completion is still 63%. Goal is reach 70% by end of Q3. Primary segment is new credit users in HCMC. Deadline is May 20 before sprint planning.
evals.expected_output: Agent should avoid re-asking provided facts, produce a decision-linked enhanced objective, and return ready if no required gaps remain.
